info.title: API.SH: Freelancer
info.description: The Freelancer API from API.SH: public Freelancer data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/freelancer-contests

get.description:
One Freelancer.com project by id (or link), open or closed: title, status, type, full description, budget, currency, bid statistics, skills, qualifications, upgrades, location, attachments, submitted and updated times and link. With `include=bids` it adds `bids`: the project's public bids (amount, hidden for sealed bids; delivery days; status; highlighted; submitted time; milestone percentage; proposal text) with each bidder's username, name, country, city, hourly rate, member-since date, rating, reviews, completed jobs, completion, on-time and on-budget rates and profile link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/freelancer-project

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `bids` adds the project's bids (adds to the cost of the call).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the Freelancer.com directory by keywords, skill, country and hourly rate, sorted by relevance or rating. Each freelancer: id, username, name, headline, country and city, hourly rate, rating, reviews count, jobs completed, completion rate, skills, member-since date, portfolio count, description, verification flags, badges, avatar and profile link. `total` is the directory count. `min_rating` keeps the freelancers on the returned page that have at least that rating. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/freelancer-users

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country name or 2-letter code, e.g. `India` or `in`.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Only freelancers on the page with at least this rating (0-5).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
